summary: Iteration 8 verification: hero SVG cache-buster + industry filter (backend, browse page, trust chip, talent industry picker). All 5 new backend tests pass. All frontend flows verified end-to-end.

minor.issue: 2 iter7 tests flaky under parallel execution (test_sse_stream_hello_and_broadcast_event, test_history_returns_runs_and_creates_new_docs). Both assertion mismatches on cross-test isolation, NOT introduced by iter8 changes. Iter8 features unaffected.

verified_functionality.hero_svg: PASS — GET /hero-atlas.svg returns 200, content-type image/svg+xml, 8708 bytes. In Playwright: present, naturalWidth=267, naturalHeight=150, complete=true. Cache-buster in place.
verified_functionality.hero_verb_rotator: PASS — verbs 'Grow', 'Ship', 'Scale' observed cycling within 8s window (Build not caught in 8s snapshot but rotator is running).
verified_functionality.backend_industry_filter: PASS — PUT /api/profile persists industries[]; GET /api/talent?industry=SaaS%20%26%20Enterprise%20Software returns 1 matching talent; GET /api/talent?industry=Healthcare%20%26%20Life%20Sciences returns 0; GET /api/talent (no param) returns 27 talents (>=26).
verified_functionality.browse_filter_banner: PASS — /browse (no param) has no filter banner; /browse?industry=SaaS%20%26%20Enterprise%20Software shows data-testid='industry-filter-banner' with label 'SaaS & Enterprise Software' and grid narrows to 1 talent card (View → count = 1 vs 27 unfiltered).
verified_functionality.clear_filter: PASS — clicking data-testid='clear-industry-filter' navigates to /browse (no query param) and banner disappears.
verified_functionality.trust_chip_flow: PASS — clicking data-testid='trust-industry-saas-enterprise-software' on / navigates to /browse?industry=SaaS%20%26%20Enterprise%20Software, banner appears, filtered grid shows correct talent.
verified_functionality.talent_industry_picker: PASS — /talent/profile shows data-testid='talent-industry-picker' with exactly 16 chip buttons. data-testid='talent-industry-saas-enterprise-software' visible. Pre-selected chips (SaaS + Fintech) have dark bg (bg-[#0B1B2B] text-white). Clicking Healthcare chip toggled from light bg to dark bg — toggle works.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate 2 flaky iter7 tests (test_sse_stream_hello_and_broadcast_event, test_history_returns_runs_and_creates_new_docs) — cross-test data leakage under xdist parallel run; unrelated to iter8 features but should be fixed for CI reliability.
critical_code_review_comments: Cache-buster ?v=2 is a fine short-term fix, but for future asset updates consider content-hash filenames (hero-atlas.[hash].svg) via build pipeline so cache-busting is automatic.
Frontend /browse page uses text link 'View →' rather than data-testid on cards; adding data-testid='talent-card-{id}' would improve testability of grid contents.
Industry chip picker uses class-based active state detection only; consider adding aria-pressed=true/false for accessibility + easier test assertions.

seed_data_creation: None new. Test talent already had industries=['SaaS & Enterprise Software','Financial Services & Fintech'] from prior curl per problem statement; re-affirmed via PUT /api/profile in test_put_profile_industries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero SVG ?v=2 cache-buster verified working. Industry filter end-to-end (self-tag path) works. Note: past-engagement-employer-industry match path was NOT explicitly exercised (only self-tagged industries verified via test talent). If future testing needs to validate that OR branch, seed an engagement between an employer with industry X and a talent with no industries[] then filter by X.
rca of the issue: User's original complaint that hero background was not visible was a browser-cache issue (HTTP response includes cache-control: no-store but user's browser likely had stale cached HTML referencing old asset). Fix (?v=2 query string) forces cache invalidation. Playwright fresh session renders hero at 267x150 natural dims, confirming server + asset are correct; user needs hard refresh or the ?v=2 will handle it on next page load.
